name: application-carousel
title: Carousel
description: Single-image-at-a-time carousel with previous/next controls and dot indicators.
useWhen: Showcasing a small set of images or featured items one at a time in a fixed amount of space.
Building a hero banner or product gallery where the user browses sequentially rather than scanning a grid.
The number of items is small enough that dot indicators stay legible (roughly 2-7).
avoidWhen: The content should all be visible and scannable at once — a grid or `scroll-area` list serves that better than hiding items behind navigation.
You have more than ~8 items — dot indicators stop being useful navigation at that count; use thumbnails or pagination instead.
Accessibility is a hard requirement and you cannot commit to keyboard support and pause-on-hover for autoplay — a static grid avoids the risk entirely.
responsiveBehavior: Fills its container width at a fixed aspect-driven height; controls remain touch-target sized (32px) at all viewport widths.
accessibility: The carousel region has role="region" with aria-roledescription="carousel" and an aria-label describing its content.
Previous/next controls are icon-only buttons with explicit aria-label text.
Each slide's alt text states its position ("Slide 2 of 3") in addition to describing the image.
Dot indicators are real buttons in a role="tablist" with aria-selected reflecting the active slide, not decorative spans.

variants.title: Carousel
variants.description: Image carousel with previous/next arrow buttons and dot slide indicators.
accessibility: Dot indicators and arrow buttons are keyboard-focusable and operable without a pointer.

variants.title: Carousel (Dark)
variants.description: Image carousel adapted for dark surfaces, with previous/next controls and dot indicators.
accessibility: Control button backgrounds carry enough opacity/contrast against varied photo content in dark mode.
